name: House of Mr. Whiteman ("the forty-pillared house"), Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of John Clarmont Whiteman's house, also known as the forty-pillared house, Macau, drawn by Harriet Daniell, copied probably from a drawing by George Chinnery. For Whiteman's house see E.1833-1928, E.1834-1928 and E.1836-1928. Harriet Daniell, who made this drawing, was the wife of James Antho
